commands.none: No commands match. Clear the filter or choose All.

sage-setup.title: Set up the dashboard
sage-setup.lede: Sign in to the WildcatSage dashboard, add the bot to your channel, and review the permissions it asks for.

sage-commands.title: Commands
sage-commands.lede: Every WildcatSage chat command. Select a command to see its options. Commands marked Mod work for moderators and the broadcaster only.

sage-custom-commands.title: Custom commands & variables
sage-custom-commands.lede: Variables you can put in custom command responses, with examples, and how AI commands write a new reply each time.

sage-personality.title: Bot personality
sage-personality.lede: Change how WildcatSage talks in your channel, and the rules that stay in place whatever you write.

sage-memory.title: Channel memory
sage-memory.lede: What WildcatSage remembers about your channel from one stream to the next, and how viewers and moderators control it.

sage-language.title: Bot language
sage-language.lede: How WildcatSage picks the language it replies in, and how to set it yourself.

sage-checkin.title: Daily check-in
sage-checkin.lede: Let viewers check in once a day with a Channel Points reward, and choose what the bot replies.

tts-setup.title: Set up the dashboard & OBS
tts-setup.lede: Configure WildcatTTS in the Web Dashboard, calibrate voice volume, and add the audio to OBS.

tts-commands.title: Commands
tts-commands.lede: Every WildcatTTS chat command. Select a command to see its options. Commands marked Mod work for moderators and the broadcaster only.

tts-voices.title: Voices & language boost
tts-voices.lede: Pick a voice from the full list, and tell the voice engine which language your chat speaks.

tts-filtering.title: Filtering & pronunciation
tts-filtering.lede: Control what TTS says aloud: describe emotes, expand chat short forms, soften rude words, and skip messages with banned words.

tts-events.title: Stream events & privacy
tts-events.lede: Choose which stream events TTS announces, how it treats other bots' commands, and how it reads links aloud.

tts-youtube.title: YouTube chat
tts-youtube.lede: Read YouTube Live chat aloud next to your Twitch chat when you stream to both.

tts-troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
tts-troubleshooting.lede: Fixes for the most common WildcatTTS problems.

overlay-obs.title: Set up in OBS
overlay-obs.lede: The Wildcat Chat Overlay shows Twitch and YouTube Live chat messages in OBS Studio. You can change its settings in the Chat Scene Creator on the web, or in the config panel of the OBS browser source.

overlay-appearance.title: Themes & appearance
overlay-appearance.lede: Generate a theme from a description, then adjust colors, fonts, and how messages appear.

overlay-emotes.title: Emotes
overlay-emotes.lede: How the overlay shows BetterTTV, FrankerFaceZ, and 7TV emotes, including stacked emotes.

overlay-scenes.title: Chat Scene Creator
overlay-scenes.lede: Save named chat scenes on the web, sync changes to OBS live, and use the config panel inside OBS.

overlay-url.title: URL parameters
overlay-url.lede: Settings you can put in the overlay URL, diagnostic messages, and demo mode.
